title: Orange Totem
description: A custom orange totem with blinded eyes and a moving outline for better and faster reflexes!
body:
## 🟠 Custom Orange Totem of Undying 🟠

Give your gameplay a fresh new look with this custom orange Totem of Undying! Featuring blinded eyes and a smooth animated outline, this totem is designed to stand out during intense fights while keeping a clean and stylish appearance.

# ✨ Features

* 🟠 Custom orange Totem of Undying
* 👀 Unique blinded-eye design
* 🔄 Animated moving outline
* ⚡ Better visibility in fast-paced situations
* 🗡️ Great for PvP, Crystal PvP, Bedwars, SkyWars, and more
* 🎨 Clean and distinctive design
* 🚀 Lightweight and easy to use

The bright orange color and moving outline make the totem easier to spot in your hand and inventory, helping you react faster during combat. Whether you're grinding PvP, playing minigames, or simply want a unique totem design, this pack offers both style and functionality.

🔥 Stand out from other players and upgrade your totem with a vibrant orange look!
